svg.title: Commercial LV cabling design - installation view
svg.desc: Cutaway isometric view of the 400 V three-tenancy supply as it is built: a padmount kiosk holding the 500 kVA transformer at the site boundary, fifteen metres of buried consumer mains in five conduits with sand bedding and marker tape, rising into the building, and a switchroom holding the floor-standing main switchboard with a metre of clear space in front. Each tenancy has its own distribution board inside its own bay, fed from the switchboard by a buried submain. The installation main earth electrode sits beside the switchroom and connects to the switchboard earth bar. The prospective fault current at the main switchboard is 8.0 kA against a 10 kA device rating.

g.text: PFC 8.0 kA · MEN at neutral bar
